caption:
Typography and structure matter more than decorative graphics.

JobRez offers nine templates, including TeXline, Stack First, and Campus One on the free tier, alongside Nova, Product Engineer, Systems Lead, ATS Dense, Staff+ Impact, and Executive Mono on Pro. Nova features a one-column or two-column layout switch.

Typefaces include Arial and Georgia for free plans, while Calibri, Cambria, and Verdana are available on Pro, with seven accent options and three density levels.

Explore templates and typography options at https://jobrez.com.
